newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - February 28.

text.p: The following were the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Half-day strike on Thursday by government doctors over wages leaves thousands waiting for treatment.

United National Party (UNP) MP Susantha Punchinilame, former UNP mayor of Ratnapura in central Sri Lanka, Mahinda Ratnatilake and 15 others produced in Ratnapura magistrate's court amid tight security. The suspects are in police custody in connection with the killing of ruling coalition lawmaker Nalanda Ellawala on February 11.
Japan to provide Sri Lanka a 22 billion rupees aid package for telecommunications, power generation, transport, urban development and small and micro industry training.
Thursday's identification parade of suspects in February 11 assassination of Nalanda Ellawala put off until March 4.
Crowds demonstrate on Thursday outside Ratnapura court where suspects in Ellawala assassination were produced.
Eight suspects in the Ellawala assassination case produced in court on Thursday.
